items.title: IPCC Opens Sixty Fifth Plenary Session in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
items.description: ADDIS ABABA, Oct 12 – The Sixty-Fifth Session of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) began today in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. IPCC member governments are meeting from 12 to 16 October to advance the IPCC work planned for the seventh assessment cycle. The Panel’s agenda for this session includes several important topics, led by […]

items.title: Cyprus closer than ever to joining Schengen but political hurdles relating to the Green Line and British Sovereign Base Areas remain
items.description: The European Commission says Cyprus is ready to join the Schengen Area. Yet questions relating to the island's division and British military bases could still complicate its path to Europe's border-free travel zone.

items.title: Germany's Wadephul calls new EU sanctions 'unprecedented' blow to Russia
items.description: The European Union has approved its largest-ever sanctions package against Moscow, targeting more than 1,000 entities tied to the military-industrial complex. The move took place in an EU foreign ministers' meeting.
